profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Hireology
profile.summary: Frontend software engineer with several years of experience. Skilled in the React and Next.js ecosystems with a passion toward writing strong, thorough unit tests. Excels at working in remote environments. Comfortable leading the architecture and development of frontend web applications. Truly enjoys helping and teaching others. Avid learner.

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked collaboratively to decide on the architecture for a brand new frontend web application, then proceeded to build it out page by page
- Regularly paired with other engineers to solve problems and/or provide mentoring, especially in the way of best testing practices
- Performed an Engineering Talk (20 minute presentation) for the greater engineering/product teams about React Testing Library and Mock Service Worker (slides available at https://rtl-deck.vercel.app)
- Led the initiative to upgrade large scale web app from React 15 to 16
- Participated in job interviews leading to multiple candidates being hired

company.name: Northwestern University - The Feinberg School of Medicine

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description:
- Lead developer on five separate front end web applications built with React, including a shopping application and a dashboard
- Built multiple reusable React component libraries, such as a full-featured rich text editor using Slate.js
- Created a GraphQL backend server written in Go and connected it on the front end with Apollo Client
- Developed multiple backend microservices in Go
- Created a CI pipeline for testing and building JavaScript applications using GitHub Actions

positions.title: Temporary Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
- Refactored an existing React/Redux application to use latest standards
- Optimized this same application to be mobile responsive

positions.title: Senior Internet Analyst
positions.description:
- Evaluated and recommended improvements on the output of a major search engine
- Employed web research skills, analytical expertise, and in-depth knowledge of web page construction and publishing techniques
- Kept up-to-date on current web and pop culture trends
- Demonstrated strong writing ability

(Same position as Leapforce, but now a different company)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Built full websites for local small businesses
- Worked with clients to successfully meet their needs and fulfill their visions
- Built several web applications and other side projects from scratch using JavaScript, React and Node.js, including a competitive drawing game, a Slackbot, a replica of the `80s electronic game Simon, a virtual calculator, a Pomodoro clock, a tic-tac-toe game and a local weather app

positions.title: Search Engine Evaluator
positions.description:
- Evaluated and recommended improvements on the output of a major search engine
- Employed web research skills, analytical expertise, and in-depth knowledge of web page construction and publishing techniques
- Kept up-to-date on current web and pop culture trends
- Demonstrated strong writing ability
